name: Retail/Sales Agent (Frontline/Cross-Sell/Front-Office)
personaDescription: Frontline agent who closes consumer/enterprise deals, runs guided activation wizards (Postpaid/Prepaid/Fixed Line/FWA/MNP), builds sales orders, and executes SIM swaps, plan changes, and CAF signing.

name: Account Manager
personaDescription: Closes enterprise deals, approves EBU discount requests via MS Dynamics, and manages fixed/mobility account relationships for assigned customers.

name: Account Manager / Channel Partner (External enterprise)
personaDescription: External enterprise account manager/channel partner supported via the 117 support channel rather than direct CRM access.

name: Fulfilment Agent / Fulfilment Team
personaDescription: Back-office role that validates and creates MNP/FNP/enterprise orders in Siebel, handles ECR/DOI submission, and manages WFM scheduling and KID/VFID mapping exceptions.

name: Back Office Fulfilment Agent (Siebel Responsibility)
personaDescription: Runs the New Fixed Line guided journey end-to-end in Siebel Open UI Desktop under the “Back Office Fulfilment” responsibility.

name: Credit Control / Collection & Credit Control
personaDescription: Sets billing-in-advance/arrears flags, approves enterprise credit terms, and confirms outstanding-dues thresholds during collections.

name: Business Finance
personaDescription: Approves enterprise account credit limits where no default limit exists.

name: IT Operations
personaDescription: Retains legacy Siebel/BRM system access for mixed CRM-BRM content after other users move to DXP.

name: Chooser
personaDescription: Sole authorised requester acting on behalf of an enterprise company, nominated on the change request.

name: Payment Support Contact
personaDescription: Enterprise customer-side contact who handles payment-related matters for the account.

name: Technical Contact
personaDescription: Enterprise customer-side contact who handles technical matters and serves as the installation site point of contact.

name: EBU Operations
personaDescription: Qualifies enterprise leads before assigning them to an account manager.

name: EBU PM (Project Manager)
personaDescription: Collects contract documents for DAPN and other enterprise services, acting as the central point of the enterprise order/IoT flow.

name: Business Care
personaDescription: Frontline enterprise customer support handling inquiries and post-activation issues for 5G/FWA devices.

name: Customer (Consumer/Enterprise/B2B2C End User)
personaDescription: End subscriber who signs CAFs/consent forms, provides ID documents, requests service changes (Home Move/TON), and can self-serve instant activation.

name: Donor Operator (Ooredoo/QTEL)
personaDescription: External telecom operator that accepts/rejects/conditionally-accepts MNP/FNP port requests within SLA and manages post-port dunning.

name: Manager/Approver (Delegation of Authority / DOA hierarchy)
personaDescription: Approves individual billing adjustments through the Delegation of Authority hierarchy.

name: Presenter (Enterprise Knowledge Base SME)
personaDescription: Internal SME who demonstrates the enterprise process knowledge base and as-is product processes.

name: Manager (Approver/Bypass/System Admin role, general)
personaDescription: Supervisory role approving migration fees, bypassing QID edits, resolving escalated limit-validation failures, and configuring Bill/Spend Limit product settings.

name: Billing Team / Billing Role
personaDescription: The only role permitted to change a customer's bill cycle.

name: Collection/Credit Control Team (Manual Suspension via Taurus)
personaDescription: Runs manual account suspension (“park my number”) as a back-office ticket process using Taurus.

name: Retention Agent / Retention Team
personaDescription: Checks penalties before disconnection, runs win-back retention offers, and closes disconnection tickets that trigger the disconnection order.

name: CDM Team / Customer Data Management
personaDescription: Handles sequential Transfer-of-Number approvals, minor-customer exceptions, and customer data governance.

name: Supervisor
personaDescription: Needs cross-agent ticket visibility — flagged in the source evidence as a gap not yet implemented.

name: Field Technician / Field Engineer (WFM/OFS/OFSC)
personaDescription: Performs on-site installations via the Oracle Field Service app — activity assessment, serial checks, activation, signature capture — and raises WFM issues/win-back tickets.

name: Rollout Team
personaDescription: Back-office team that receives Siebel order tasks generated from field-technician WFM activities.

name: Sales Team (Win-back)
personaDescription: Handles win-back retention offers before a fixed-line installation is cancelled.

name: Managing Queue / CDM / BOQ / QATQ (routing queues)
personaDescription: The set of back-office ticket-routing queues used for Transfer-of-Number processing.

name: MOI (Ministry of Interior, external system/authority)
personaDescription: External authority supplying ID validity/cancellation data used to detect third-party Transfer-of-Number fraud.

name: Store Agent (TON)
personaDescription: Validates documents and processes Transfer of Number transactions in-store.

name: Business Analyst (Rana)
personaDescription: Internal delivery-team role performing revenue-management business analysis.

name: Solution/Financial Architect (Marishi)
personaDescription: Internal delivery-team role covering solution and financial architecture.

name: Retail Agent (Retail Operations Stakeholder - Giri)
personaDescription: Internal stakeholder providing retail operations oversight.

name: Authorized Officer
personaDescription: Can flag an account to override the maximum mobility line cap under CRA rules.

name: Credit Control / Billing Stakeholder (Anwar Mishra)
personaDescription: Internal stakeholder overseeing billing, payments, and credit policy.

name: Security Stakeholder (Ali)
personaDescription: Internal stakeholder responsible for security review of the journey/architecture.

name: Qatar Visa Center (QVC) Staff
personaDescription: Offshore staff performing prepaid registration via the Integrated System channel.

name: Offshore Airport Staff / Third-Party Partner (Offshore Prepaid Activation)
personaDescription: Manually activates offshore airport prepaid/postpaid sales via SFTP/VSA, producing an Accept or Reject outcome.

name: Fulfilment Manager Sign-off (Fixed & Mobile Fulfilment and Technical Support)
personaDescription: Gives fulfilment/technical-support sign-off on activation procedures, including direct registration rejection.

name: GTM & Channel Operations
personaDescription: Provides go-to-market and channel-operations sign-off.

name: Team Manager / Approver / Manager (Order Approval, Test Manager)
personaDescription: Reviews and approves/rejects orders and leads in the approval queues, reassigns lead ownership, and holds sole authority to cancel FDO disconnection requests.

name: Retention Team (FDO Disconnection Cancellation)
personaDescription: Sole role authorised to cancel Future-Dated-Order disconnection requests.

name: Retail Agent (Lead Owner, reassignment target)
personaDescription: Receives reassigned leads into their own queue and can edit lead details.

name: Back Office / Admin (broad org-wide access)
personaDescription: Has org-wide lead visibility and broader module access spanning nearly all functional areas, including Reject/Retire actions.

name: DSA / Store / Field Engineer (sales channel attribution)
personaDescription: Recorded as the sales-channel attribution (Direct Sales Agent, Store, or Field Engineer) on the signed acceptance form.

name: Dispatcher/Back-Office WFM User
personaDescription: Views and manages WFM technician activities, reassigns technicians, and transfers CPE/SIM inventory between resources.

name: CSR / Desktop Agent (Vanilla channel)
personaDescription: Manually creates/modifies orders through non-wizard Contact/Account/Sales Order screens and edits installed CPE asset attributes.

name: Fulfillment Team (ECR Details - inferred)
personaDescription: Fills the ECR Details field on orders — referenced in source documents but not directly observed acting.

name: System Administrator (Product Promotions admin)
personaDescription: Configures Bill Limit Mapping/Spend Limit product settings (Agent Min Value, SL Default, Active Flag).

name: System user SADMIN (backend/system account)
personaDescription: Automated backend account that creates/processes orders generated by the Unica campaign/Autobase migration engine.

name: Channel Manager
personaDescription: Approves partner/tablet-channel orders before submission.

name: Offshore Retailer / Channel Partner (VSA/BSA)
personaDescription: External channel partner provisioning prepaid/postpaid connections via the VSA/BSA system.

name: Customer Care / Telesales & Retention / Complaints / Direct Sales / Mass Market / Mini Store / Retail & Franchise agents (role families)
personaDescription: A grouped family of frontline and back-office roles, each performing its own named function (sales, retention, complaints, fulfilment, billing, collections, data management).

name: Sales / Fulfilment (VFID-KID mapping team)
personaDescription: Manually resolves ambiguous KID-to-VFID address-mapping cases.

name: Field Survey Team
personaDescription: Maps generated Vodafone IDs (VFID) to Kahramaa IDs (KID) on-site.

name: Network Team
personaDescription: Owns IMS inventory data, outside Technology department control.

name: Business/Strategy Team
personaDescription: Owns the GIS-to-IMS process and manual data hot-loads.

name: Agent viewing Open UI Desktop (Account 360, Care Agent)
personaDescription: Looks up account/asset summaries, usage/balance, manages add-ons/promotions, and creates leads from Account 360.

name: Complaints Team (Mobile and Fixed)
personaDescription: Handles trouble tickets by hashtag/actual-issue taxonomy and raises tickets from MVA-originated customer request reports.

name: Back Office (generic activity channel)
personaDescription: Processes activities logged via a generic “Back Office” channel, e.g. language-change requests.

name: Product Team
personaDescription: Supplies the plan-to-star-number pricing eligibility matrix.

name: Solution Architect / Business Owner / IT Owner / Track Lead / Test Manager / Delivery Manager (Governance)
personaDescription: Formal document governance/sign-off roles not yet assigned to named individuals.

name: Agent (in DXP)
personaDescription: Performs DXP onboarding steps (ID validation, cart building, plan selection, CAF, payment) and initiates modify orders (suspend/resume/plan change).

name: Assisted Care Agent
personaDescription: Receives customer queries and retrieves aggregated Customer 360 data (billing, CDR, network status, orders).

name: MNP Team
personaDescription: Validates activities inside MNP Port-Out tickets, assigning Success/Failed status.

name: FL Agents (Front Line Agents)
personaDescription: Fills designated Ticket Homepage fields per trouble-ticket type and creates tickets from templates for complaints/issues.
